title: Critical Evaluation of Self-Correction in Large Language Models for Reasoning

defines.name: intrinsic self-correction
defines.definition: A setting in which an LLM attempts to correct its initial responses using only its own internal capabilities, without external feedback.

problem: Prior claims that LLM self-correction improves reasoning are often confounded by external oracle labels, unequal inference cost, and prompt design effects, while intrinsic self-correction itself frequently fails or degrades performance.
